# `Browser.Share`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Share — invoke the platform share sheet over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` (`share`) invokes the share sheet, and an inbound
`JsMsg` carries the outcome — a completion, a user cancellation, or a typed
unavailability. Both cross the same seal codec and fail-closed port discipline as
every other port; there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses `js-port:share`
(import-derived, keyed on the canonical `Ipe.Browser.Share` path prefix via
`WebCapability::for_browser_module`, alias-immune); only the top-level app's
`[capabilities] accepts` set can grant it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Share.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs and
    the full `Payload` surface (`title` / `text` / `url`).
  * this module is the high-level layer: `share` returns a `Task Error ()` via
    the correlated port→Task bridge (a completion succeeds; a cancellation or an
    absent API resolves to a typed `Err`), and `outcomes` is the inbound
    subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed `Result Error ()`. The
    inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: a cancellation becomes a typed `Err`, never a
    silently dropped variant.

## `share`

```ipe
share : Internals.Payload -> Task Error ()
```

`share payload` — invoke the platform share sheet with the given payload, as a
`Task Error ()`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). The served JS handler calls
`navigator.share`; a completion resolves the `Task` with `()`, and a user
cancellation or an absent API resolves it to a typed `Err`.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:share`; the app must grant it with
`accepts = [ JsPort Share ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `outcomes`

```ipe
outcomes : (Result Error () -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`outcomes toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error ()` — a `Shared` becomes `Ok`, a cancellation / unavailability a
typed `Err`.
